title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-16
content:
Purpose: quick alignment ahead of weekly exec staff. Keep to 45 minutes. Focus: Dedicated launch readiness, private deployment contracts, and Q2 forecast variance.

Attendees (TBD): Laura (owner), Michael (infra), Aisha (product), Ryan (sales ops), Priya (finance - may join for forecast), Ben (SRE - optional).

Agenda: 
- 5m: Quick wins / shoutouts (team updates)
  - New Dedicated onboarding flow rolled out to beta customers (infra + product)
  - Observability dashboard baseline established for token-level cost (console)
- 15m: Dedicated GA readiness checklist (Michael + Aisha)
  - Current outstanding infra items: autoscaler edge-case under 8k rps, GPU memory fragmentation bug on mixed-model hosts (infra ticket ENG-1428)
  - Product: UI copy and documentation (in progress), rollout plan for canary -> 20% -> 100%
  - Ask: decide on hard freeze date for model variant additions before GA (proposal: 2026-03-23)
- 10m: Private deployment sales pipeline & contract blockers (Ryan + Legal touchpoint)
  - 3 large opportunities in negotiation: FinBank (security + KMS), HealthCorp (on-prem audit), EduCloud (multi-region)
  - Common blocker: indemnity clause + data residency language. Legal to propose standard clause by 2026-03-18
- 10m: Q2 revenue & capacity forecast variance (Priya)
  - Capacity plan: reserved capacity commit conversion rate tracking below plan (metric: commit_conversion = 6% this quarter vs 12% target)
  - Ask: approve temporary incentive (2 months credits) for Dedicated sign-ups to hit ARR targets?
- 5m: AOB / action review

Notes / talking points (to mention):
- Dedicated: stress that GA must have explicit fallback policies defined (model routing policy + billing fallback). SRE wants a dry-run of failure modes on 2026-03-20.
- Private: emphasize KMS/HSM integration timeline (target: 2026-04-15) to avoid losing FinBank deal.
- Optimize: highlight two quick wins from the optimizer: (1) prefix cache TTL increase for chat bots reduced tokens by ~8% in beta, (2) suggested quantization profiles for llamaX-13B to cut GPU memory by 20% - ops to validate.

Open questions (need decisions in meeting):
- Hard freeze date for GA model catalog changes? (proposal 2026-03-23)
- Approve incentive credits for Dedicated sign-ups? (finance OK/NO)
- Legal: can we accept customer-proposed indemnity language with liability cap tied to monthly spend? (legal needs guidance)

Action items (owner - due):
- Michael Chen - run autoscaler failure dry-run and share postmortem notes (due 2026-03-20)
- Aisha Patel - finalize GA rollout doc + share canary plan + freeze date proposal (due 2026-03-18)
- Ryan O'Neal - consolidate customer contract blocker list and escalate top 2 to legal w/ suggested compromises (due 2026-03-17)
- Priya Nair - update Q2 forecast with conversion sensitivity (3 scenarios) and present slide (due 2026-03-18)
- Ben Liu - run on-prem KMS integration proof-of-concept and short write-up (due 2026-03-22)
- Legal (K. Singh) - produce standard indemnity/residency clause options (due 2026-03-18)

Follow-up plan: capture decisions in confluence page (confluence:ENG-1428-service-availability) and create follow-up JIRA tasks under EPIC OPS-3842. I'll take notes during the meeting and update the confluence with action items and owners.

Quick prep for presenters:
- Michael: focus on "what could break" scenarios and mitigation timeline (3 slides max).
- Aisha: walk through canary -> rollout timeline and customer communication plan (1 slide).
- Priya: bring 1-slide view of best/likely/worst revenue scenarios and capacity impact.

Misc scratch (to move to confluence later):
- Checklist for GA: docs done, infra tests green, SRE runbook, support runbook, pricing commit published, legal templates reviewed.
- Risk matrix: top risk = contract/legal delay (probable, high impact), infra autoscaler frag (possible, med impact), cost regression on embeddings (possible, low-med).

Notes to self: keep meeting tight; avoid deep technical tangents - spin those to separate follow-up with infra/product owners.
